Two-stage reveal on click

Clicking the trigger changes nothing synchronously (so the settle-wait's own baseline capture, which runs right after the click, sees the pre-change state - matching a real click whose optimistic UI update is scheduled async, not applied inline in the click handler). 50ms later a loading-state class appears and holds for 250ms - shorter than `_STABLE_HOLD_SECONDS` (400ms) but longer than one poll step (100ms), so a settle-wait that declares victory after a single quiet poll step would still be fooled by it. Only at 300ms does the real content replace it - mirroring the empanad.app click that kicks off an async fetch before re-rendering (see wiki/crawl4ai-integration-pitfalls.md's hydration-wait entry and this repo's docs/dev/crawlers/crawl4ai_crawler.md#_stable_hold_ seconds for the real timings this fixture is modeled on).
